{{C|[[The Essential Legends Collection|Essential Legends cover]]}} |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Bantam Spectra]] |early release= |release date=[[January]] [[1996]]''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]'' |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=388 |isbn=9780553568011 |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=*[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron (abridged audiobook)|Abridged]] *[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron (unabridged audiobook)|Unabridged]] |timeline=[[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' to [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. |series=[[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'' novel series]] |preceded by=''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' |followed by=[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble|''Wedge's Gamble'']] }} '''''X-Wing: Rogue Squadron''''' is the first installment in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''X-Wing'']] series of novels, first published in [[1996]]. It was written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]]. Narration for the audio version was performed by [[Henry Thomas]]. The book, occurring in [[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]], chronicles the re-creation of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and the [[First Battle of Borleias|First]] and [[Second Battle of Borleias|Second Battles]] of [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]]. The planet is then used as a launching point for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] taking of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the second book of the series, ''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''.
